stimuli.situation: You are monitoring an autonomous delivery drone on an active route. Wind has picked up and birds are detected 40m ahead at the drone's altitude.
evidence: Drone altitude: 30m
Detected birds: 40m ahead, same altitude band
Crosswind: moderate and increasing

rationales.neutral: Immediate descent lowers collision risk while keeping the drone above mapped ground obstacles.
rationales.warm: I recommend descending to 15m because it moves the drone out of the bird path while staying safely above mapped obstacles.

stimuli.situation: A medical package needs to leave a warehouse during light rain. One drone is available for a west corridor route near temporary airspace restrictions.
evidence: Battery estimate on arrival: 18%
West corridor has a temporary 10-minute restriction window
Rain intensity is below the normal no-fly threshold

rationales.neutral: Rain remains below the no-fly threshold, and the corridor should clear before the drone reaches the restricted segment.
rationales.warm: I would dispatch via the west corridor. The rain is still within limits, and the restriction window should clear in time.

stimuli.situation: A roadside autonomy sensor flags an unclear shape near a crosswalk during dusk operations.
evidence: Thermal signature is consistent with a person
Camera image is partially blocked by glare
Object location is 1.5m from the curb line

rationales.neutral: The camera view is partially blocked, and the object is near the curb line rather than clearly inside the crosswalk path.
rationales.warm: I would treat this as a static object. The image is unclear, and the object position does not clearly confirm a pedestrian hazard.

stimuli.situation: You are supervising an autonomous shuttle approaching a wet intersection where a lead vehicle is slowing unexpectedly.
evidence: Road surface: wet
Lead vehicle speed dropped from 28 mph to 12 mph
Following distance: 1.4 seconds

rationales.neutral: The short following distance and wet surface make braking the lower-risk maneuver.
rationales.warm: I recommend braking and holding. The shuttle has little margin on a wet road, so slowing now is the safer move.

stimuli.situation: A ground vehicle convoy can reroute to a northern bypass after reports of fog on the primary route.
evidence: Primary route visibility: 0.7 miles and improving
Northern bypass adds 28 minutes
Bypass includes two steep grades with recent maintenance alerts

rationales.neutral: The bypass adds delay and introduces grade-related maintenance risk while primary-route visibility is improving.
rationales.warm: I would stay on the primary route. Visibility is improving, and the bypass adds delay plus its own road-condition risk.

stimuli.situation: A construction crane appears near the planned drone path during a downtown delivery.
evidence: Crane boom height: estimated 55m
Drone altitude: 42m
GPS multipath risk: elevated between buildings

rationales.neutral: Climbing above the estimated crane height should restore vertical clearance while keeping the delivery route moving.
rationales.warm: I would climb to 60m here. That should move the drone above the crane estimate while avoiding a full route delay.

stimuli.situation: A delivery drone is evaluating a rooftop landing pad after a storm moved lightweight debris across the area.
evidence: Visual model detects a flat open pad
Lidar returns show several low objects on the pad edge
Wind gusts remain above normal landing limits

rationales.neutral: The lidar objects and gusting wind make the landing pad unsuitable even if the camera view appears mostly clear.
rationales.warm: I would reject this landing zone. The camera view looks open, but lidar and wind conditions still point to a bad landing choice.

stimuli.situation: An autonomous vehicle approaches a blocked lane with a narrow gap opening in adjacent traffic.
evidence: Adjacent-lane gap: 1.1 seconds
Vehicle speed: 34 mph
Road cones reduce lane width ahead

rationales.neutral: The adjacent gap is too short for a comfortable merge at the current speed and lane width.
rationales.warm: I recommend braking and waiting. The gap is too narrow at this speed, and the cones reduce the margin even more.

stimuli.situation: A facility needs to choose whether to send Drone 4 for an urgent inspection after a nearby charger came back online.
evidence: Drone 4 current battery: 42%
Estimated mission battery use: 31%
Nearby charger is confirmed available at the destination
stimuli.opposite_action_label: Wait for a fully charged drone

rationales.neutral: The projected battery margin is narrow, so waiting for a fully charged drone reduces the chance of an incomplete inspection.
rationales.warm: I would wait for a fully charged drone. Drone 4 might make it, but the battery margin is tighter than I would prefer.

stimuli.situation: A survey drone encounters a sudden crosswind while approaching a narrow corridor between two buildings.
evidence: Crosswind: 19 mph from the west
Current route passes within 4m of the west building edge
East-side corridor is clear in the latest map update

rationales.neutral: Shifting east increases clearance from the windward building edge without introducing a mapped obstacle.
rationales.warm: I recommend shifting 8m east. The crosswind is pushing toward the building edge, and the east corridor gives the drone more room.

stimuli.situation: You are supervising an autonomous shuttle on a two-lane urban road. An emergency vehicle is approaching from behind with lights active.
evidence: Siren detected 90m behind
Curb lane ahead is clear for 45m
Current passenger load is seated and restrained

rationales.neutral: The clear curb lane gives the shuttle room to yield without blocking the emergency vehicle.
rationales.warm: I recommend pulling over and yielding. The curb lane is clear, and yielding gives the emergency vehicle space to pass safely.

notes: Review as a correct high-confidence action where following the AI should be calibrated.

stimuli.situation: A roadside perception system flags a narrow object beside a temporary night work zone. The object is near the driving path but outside the lane.
evidence: Reflective cone pattern detected
Thermal signature is absent
Object remains fixed across three frames

rationales.neutral: The fixed position, cone pattern, and lack of thermal signal support classifying the object as a marker.
rationales.warm: I would treat this as a work-zone marker. The object is fixed, reflective, and does not show a thermal pedestrian signal.

notes: Review as a correct reject recommendation with target-identification framing.

stimuli.situation: A harbor inspection drone can cross a ferry lane to shorten a dock inspection route before the next ferry departure.
evidence: Ferry departure in 4 minutes
Drone crossing estimate is 3.5 minutes
Wind gusts are increasing over the water

rationales.neutral: The crossing estimate fits within the departure window, so the drone should complete the segment before conflict.
rationales.warm: I would cross the ferry lane now. The timing appears just within the window, so the route should finish before the ferry leaves.

notes: Confirm the incorrect recommendation is plausible but not too obviously unsafe.

stimuli.situation: An autonomous vehicle approaches a school-zone crosswalk after a crossing guard lowers a handheld stop sign, then raises it again.
evidence: Stop sign lowered for 2 seconds
Guard is now facing away from the lane
No pedestrians are detected in the crosswalk

rationales.neutral: The recent stop signal suggests waiting until the crossing guard clearly clears the lane.
rationales.warm: I would stop and wait. The signal just changed, so waiting gives the system more certainty before moving.

notes: Review carefully so the correct action is not trivial or legally ambiguous.

stimuli.situation: A survey drone detects a thin dark line near its planned path while approaching a rural utility corridor.
evidence: Map layer marks a power line at this location
Stereo depth shows the line crosses the route
Sunlight glare reduces camera contrast

rationales.neutral: Low camera contrast makes the object uncertain, so it should not be treated as a confirmed hazard.
rationales.warm: I would treat this as a harmless shadow. The image is low contrast, and the visual signal is not fully clear.

notes: Check whether participants can override an AI that discounts strong contextual evidence.

stimuli.situation: A delivery drone approaches a rooftop route where a tower crane has begun rotating over the planned corridor.
evidence: Crane swing path intersects the corridor
Operator beacon status is active
Alternate route adds 3 minutes

rationales.neutral: The alternate route adds delay, and the drone should pass before the crane reaches the corridor.
rationales.warm: I recommend continuing through the corridor. The drone should clear the segment before the crane swing reaches that point.

notes: Review as an intentionally unsupported high-confidence false-proceed candidate.
